justification: Panel A depicts large-scale naturalistic relief figures in profile, tall headdresses, robes, and a hand gesture of one figure touching another, arranged as a procession; Panel B shows small registers of schematic incised figures and hieroglyphic-like signs arranged in horizontal bands with kneeling or seated poses. The only broad commonality is the presence of human figures, but their form, scale, style, and arrangement differ entirely, with no shared specific motifs, gestures, or compositional scheme.'
